item.title: Show HN: Saggar, a Mac terminal that keeps sessions and your attention organized
item.summary: Hi HN, like many of you talented folk, I’ve been building more, faster than ever. I built Saggar after my terminal stopped feeling like a tool and started feeling like a tab-management problem. Let me know you think!
